related_questions.question: What happens if I get the COVID vaccine while infected?
related_questions.snippet: If you accidentally get vaccinated during a COVID infection, you may get more intense side effects from the vaccine. That's because some COVID symptoms and vaccine side effects can feel quite similar. The shot will still work to boost your immune system the way it's supposed to.

related_questions.question: How is a vaccine different from an active infection?
related_questions.snippet: Natural immunity results from being infected by a disease-causing organism, whether the infection is symptomatic or not. Vaccine-induced immunity results from being exposed to killed or weakened bacteria or viruses—or even just important pieces of them—through vaccination.

related_questions.question: Are you contagious after the COVID-19 vaccine?
related_questions.snippet: After I get the vaccine, am I contagious? No. The COVID-19 vaccines contain deactivated proteins and will not cause you to be contagious, rather they trigger your natural immune response. However, you should still take ACTion to protect others even after you've received a first or second dose.
